o_proj: excluded from allocation AND quantization (fp16 in all configs); reason: per-head PCA path only exists in AV representation
shared_input_note: q/k/v (and gate/up) share inputs but masks are independent per projection; scored strategies coincide by construction, RND independent per projection

formats.main: nvfp4 blk16 (two-level E4M3 scale, act-MSE search steps=3 fast)

feasible_quota: F_l={h: h%32==0, (d-h)%16==0}; within h=nearest to r*d (tie smaller); across: prefix-increment 32-chunk greedy at same H
packing: [unselected asc | selected asc] column permutation applied to activations and weight columns; block scales recomputed on final layout

score_defs.av: centered variance of Z=XU on PCA rep (clamped at 0); basis is UNCENTERED second moment X^T X, 1pct damping, eigh ascending; down_proj rep = online Hadamard

fit: wikitext2-train 512x2048 seed0 window sequence; score collection = first 2 windows (4096 tokens, all projections same token positions); GPTQ = first 128 windows (prefix subset)
heldout: 32x2048 wikitext2-train windows, seed 31001, rejected overlap with the 512 fit windows; offsets recorded per run json
ppl: wiki test full (seqlen2048, equal windows => window-mean == token-mean NLL), C4 val 256 windows seed0; input sha in run jsons

gptq.env_defaults: PROMIX_ACT_MSE=1 steps3 fast, PROMIX_WEIGHT_MSE=1 steps3, PROMIX_WEIGHT_2LEVEL=1 (metricsweep main-curve protocol)

error_metric: E_l=SSE/(ENERGY+1e-12) on teacher inputs, float64 accumulation; mean/std over eligible layers ddof=0 (between-layer spread)
allocations_note: allocations.jsonl stores per-module h + ids_sha256 + score_summary; full stable channel ids reproducible from scores/*.pt + deterministic tie rule via rd_m31.py alloc --dump (sha-verifiable)
